card.name: Odd split-off pieces in drug label text
card.fires_on: Short, odd pieces that interrupt a word, number or phrase in drug label text, often right after a drug or medical term. Examples are the 'z' in glomerular, the 'a' after Severity and 'is' after a drug name.

modes.label: Letter inside medical term
modes.description: A stray letter or short piece sits where a medical word is split or continues.
